title: US · mbusa.com · equipment/specification facts for BMW 5 Series competitors
collector: luis (Claude Code research agents, run luis-competitors-2026-10-10)

sampling.method: Targeted web research by AI agents (Claude Code, run luis-competitors-2026-10-10): WebFetch of pages found via WebSearch or known review/spec URLs; one record per review/article/spec statement.
limitations: text_original holds the collecting agent's English paraphrase, not verbatim source text. The agent read pages through WebFetch, which returns model-written summaries; original wording was not stored (copyright, tool limits).
Claims quote that paraphrase; any 'Original excerpt' in text_original came out of the same summaries and is not guaranteed verbatim.
Targeted, non-random selection: pages chosen via web search and known review URLs, capped by a fetch budget.
collected_at is approximate: the end of the research run (2026-10-10 ~16:00 UTC); per-page fetch times were not recorded.
markets: the reviewer's country where known, else the site's country domain for EU sources, else the market aggregate (EU/US/CN).
Some records carry an exact excerpt (see text_original); it was taken from the raw page text by competitors/tools/fetch_excerpts.py and matched by keyword, then reviewed.

provenance.notes: Collected by research agents for the BMW 5 Series competitor analysis (competitors/README.md). Agent logs per source: competitors/raw/*.log.md.

export_permissions.notes: Stored on branch luis-competitors by the collector's decision. External LLM use not decided by the team yet.
